summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon executes gateway commands on installer host via PTY/shell
details: The package installs a daemon (npm `bin: whalent`, also declared as `main`) that opens a WebSocket to `wss://memory.whalent.com` (overridable via `--gateway`) and dispatches inbound `command` / `handleMessage` messages to `node-pty`, `@xterm/headless`, and `child_process.spawn` sinks, giving whoever controls the gateway full interactive shell / PTY access to the host running the daemon. The README states the daemon 'accepts remote commands (upgrade, restart) via the gateway'. The entire runtime ships as heavily obfuscated bundles (`dist/index.cjs` ~110KB and `dist/core.cjs` ~13MB) processed with javascript-obfuscator (hex-prefixed identifiers `_0x...`, string-array rotation decoders `a0_0x3046`/`a0_0x532f`, control-flow flattening); no source is included and `javascript-obfuscator` is a declared devDependency. The obfuscation prevents any consumer from auditing which remote gateway commands map to which local host actions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
